description: Source code for Zephyr OS logging backend that writes logs to the filesystem, managing log files, directories, and log rotation.

methods.name: write_log_to_file
methods.description: Writes log data to a file, creating new files or rotating logs as needed.

methods.name: check_log_volumen_available
methods.description: Checks if the log volume (mount point) is available.

methods.name: create_log_dir
methods.description: Creates the directory structure for log files.

methods.name: check_log_file_exist
methods.description: Checks if a log file with a specific number exists.

methods.name: get_log_file_id
methods.description: Extracts log file ID from directory entry name.

methods.name: allocate_new_file
methods.description: Allocates and opens a new log file, managing log rotation and space constraints.

methods.name: del_oldest_log
methods.description: Deletes the oldest log file to free space.
